structured.answer: A פיקדון means you lock money in the bank for a set time and get interest (the example used 1.8% a year), minus 15% tax. You can only take it out at the end, and breaking it early needs the bank's OK and costs a fine of unknown size. I didn't put money in, partly because the calculator showed 68,270 ₪ left after putting in 70,000 ₪.

stuck.why: 'נשאר לכם 68,270 ₪' sits under 'ההפקדות שלכם 70,000 ₪', so it looked like I lose money. Maybe it's the 'בכסף של היום' toggle, but nothing says so next to the numbers.
The cost says only 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע', with no shekel amount, so I couldn't tell what locking the money really costs.

stuck.where: Red box about breaking the deposit early
stuck.why: It says the site doesn't calculate the penalty, so I'm left not knowing how much I'd lose if I needed the money.
